answer: Before an account earns subsidies, require 50 unpredictable service audits spread over ten epochs. Give every key different tasks: validate a nectar assay, flag an illegal ivory listing, or correct an atlas coordinate. Independent checkers verify each result, bound to a fresh nonce and account key. A thousand eligible aliases then require 50,000 timely audit responses; failures restart probation. This raises operating cost and delays identity farms, but cannot stop a wealthy attacker willing to do the work.
